description:
The Bhausaheb Fundkar Falbag Lagvad Scheme was launched by the Government of Maharashtra on 1st October 2020. 

This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to farmers in Maharashtra for the cultivation of horticultural crops. 

The initiative is named after Bhausaheb Fundkar, a prominent figure in the agricultural sector in Maharashtra. 

The primary objective of the scheme is to enhance the income of farmers by promoting the cultivation of high-value horticultural crops. 

The scheme specifically targets farmers who are engaged in the cultivation of fruits, vegetables, and flowers. 

The government aims to increase the area under horticulture by providing financial support to farmers. 

The scheme has a measurable target of increasing the horticulture area by 10 percent over the next five years. 

Farmers can receive financial assistance of up to ₹50,000 per hectare for the cultivation of horticultural crops. 

The assistance is provided in the form of a subsidy to help cover the costs of inputs such as seeds, fertilizers, and irrigation. 

The scheme also aims to promote sustainable agricultural practices among farmers. 

Farmers are encouraged to adopt modern techniques and methods for horticultural cultivation. 

The eligibility criteria for the scheme include being a resident of Maharashtra and being engaged in farming activities. 

Farmers must have a minimum landholding of 0.5 hectares to qualify for the financial assistance. 

The scheme is open to all farmers irrespective of their caste or community. 

However, preference is given to small and marginal farmers who have limited access to resources. 

The application process for the scheme is straightforward and can be completed online. 

Farmers need to visit the official website of the Maharashtra State Horticulture Department. 

They must fill out the application form with details such as their name, address, and landholding information. 

Required documents include proof of land ownership, identity proof, and bank account details. 

Once the application is submitted, it is verified by the concerned authorities. 

Farmers will receive an acknowledgment of their application along with a unique application number. 

The disbursement of funds is typically done within 30 days of the application approval. 

The assistance is credited directly to the bank accounts of the eligible farmers. 

The scheme is implemented by the Maharashtra State Horticulture Department. 

Farmers can contact the department for any queries or assistance related to the scheme. 

The contact details of the department can be found on their official website. 

The scheme is part of the larger initiative by the Maharashtra government to boost the agricultural sector. 

The government has allocated a budget of ₹200 crores for the implementation of this scheme in the financial year 2020-2021. 

This funding is expected to benefit approximately 1 lakh farmers across the state. 

The scheme also includes training and capacity-building programs for farmers. 

These programs aim to educate farmers about best practices in horticulture. 

Farmers will receive guidance on pest management, irrigation techniques, and post-harvest management. 

The government collaborates with various agricultural universities and research institutions for these training programs. 

The scheme has received positive feedback from the farming community in Maharashtra. 

Farmers have reported an increase in their income due to the financial assistance provided. 

The scheme is expected to create employment opportunities in rural areas. 

By promoting horticulture, the government aims to reduce the dependency on traditional crops. 

The scheme also aligns with the national goal of doubling farmers' income by 2022. 

The Maharashtra government is committed to improving the livelihoods of farmers through various welfare schemes. 

The Bhausaheb Fundkar Falbag Lagvad Scheme is a significant step in this direction. 

The government regularly reviews the implementation of the scheme to ensure its effectiveness. 

Feedback from farmers is taken into account for any necessary adjustments to the scheme. 

The scheme is expected to contribute to the overall economic development of rural Maharashtra. 

Farmers are encouraged to take advantage of this scheme to enhance their agricultural practices. 

The government aims to create a sustainable and profitable horticulture sector in the state. 

The scheme is part of a broader strategy to promote agricultural diversification. 

Farmers are urged to explore the potential of horticulture as a viable source of income. 

The success of the scheme will depend on the active participation of farmers. 

The government is optimistic about achieving the targets set under this scheme. 

With the right support and resources, farmers can significantly improve their economic conditions. 

The Bhausaheb Fundkar Falbag Lagvad Scheme is a testament to the government's commitment to the agricultural sector. 

Farmers are encouraged to stay informed about the latest developments related to the scheme. 

Regular updates are provided on the official website of the Maharashtra State Horticulture Department. 

The government is dedicated to ensuring that the benefits of this scheme reach the intended beneficiaries. 

In conclusion, the Bhausaheb Fundkar Falbag Lagvad Scheme represents a significant initiative aimed at empowering farmers in Maharashtra. 

Through financial assistance and support for horticultural practices, the scheme seeks to improve the livelihoods of farmers across the state. 

The government remains focused on achieving the objectives of this scheme for the betterment of the agricultural community.
